svg.title: Nightglass — The Hollow Citadel Floor Plan
svg.desc: A large fictional chess-style top-down map of the Hollow Citadel, showing rooms, passages, stores, watchers, bells, and one black post-run trace.
svg.text: FICTIONAL CHESS-STYLE MAP · ROOMS, PASSAGES, WATCHERS, BELLS, AND STORES
A · THE OUTER RING / FOUR APPROACHES
The ring keeps the four approaches, the keeper posts, the sealed papers, and every doorway into the citadel.
NORTH CAUSEWAY · sealed papers and old maps
SOUTH CAUSEWAY · return lane and quiet exit
WEST CAUSEWAY · bearer tokens and keeper rites
EAST CAUSEWAY · echo stones and borrowed masks
The rooms are scattered through the keep; the passages show imagined movement between doors, stores, watchers, and bells.

g.text: the heart's two wells · tide and pressure

svg.text: The hall carries five imagined tests: name → twin seal → tide mark → ledger → mask returned.
E1 · ARCHIVE OF PAPERS — sealed notes / lockbox / candle tests
E2 · LEDGER CHAMBER — owed tides / safe draw / clearing
E3 · BELL ARCHIVE — alarms / traces / caught or clear
F · THE BLACK TRACE — DRAW AFTER THE RUN
Leave this line blank in your imagination; after a run, draw the path that actually happened and mark where the bell rang.
a promise cleared before the purse is full
a mask returns twice to the same doorway
a stone path meets the last echo
seeds, sunset, ash, and the final gathering
watcher = a keeper of an unseen oath
watch-eye = a place where a story can be remembered
bell = the run stops or changes shape
door = a threshold between imagined places
green · living stores and hidden gardens
The single black trace is the only planned line; draw it after the tale is run.
NIGHTGLASS · fictional visual artifact · the legend keeps the hidden correspondence · no external image dependencies
